title: Safety Invariant for the Program
statement: For every Boolean input $x$ and abstract configuration consisting of a control state, fifteen natural-number registers, and an optional Boolean result, the following condition holds. If the state is live and its instruction compares two registers, their indices are distinct; if it compares a register with the first payload of a plain encoded input or with either payload of a nested encoded input, respectively, then the input has the corresponding valid canonical encoding; and if it calls a decider, its argument-register list has no repetitions. No further condition is imposed in all other cases, including halted configurations and nondeterministic choice states.
hypotheses_covered: The input is a Boolean word
The configuration has a control state in the program's label type, fifteen natural-number register values, and an optional Boolean result
